question: Do previous-record production and/or weather improve next-record power predictions beyond 001 power and calendar inputs?
missing_weather_handling: Preserve original NaN and use HistGradientBoostingRegressor native missing-value handling; do not drop evaluation hours or impute
comparison: Same May and June timestamps as 001, mean and peak targets, pooled and foldwise MAE, high-onset and high-continued errors
availability_assumption: The immediately previous record's production and weather observations have arrived before prediction
decision: Require consistent improvement across folds and report concentration in repeated daily profiles; do not search additional lags or settings
